description: local-ollama.json with Meta's llama3.1:8b as coder A, to compare models on the same responses. Every role on models served by Ollama on this machine: no key, no cost, no respondent text leaves the machine (ADR-0049). Coder A llama3.1:8b (Meta), coder B, the judge and the refactorer gemma4:12b (Google). Pull first: ollama pull llama3.1:8b gemma4:12b embeddinggemma
